text:
mike: heads-up — ap-southeast-1 gpu-pool-2 has been at 98% pod CPU/GPU util for ~30m, mesh pod scheduling is piling more requests onto the same hot shards. tail latency + p95 tokens are climbing.

infra-bot: [ALERT] region=ap-southeast-1 pool=gpu-pool-2 saturation=true replicas=120 util=98% backlog=1.3k

sasha: confirmed, seeing heavy mosaic-4b and open-embedding requests. admission control started shedding low-priority requests ~20m ago.

lucy: which workloads are getting shed? any reserved customers impacted?

sasha: reserved customers (acme-corp) are still served; PS: the scheduler bumped fairshare weights for model=mosaic-4b by mistake earlier — that amplification is probably the root cause.

mike: ah — looks like a rollout changed weights yesterday. @chen any idea who pushed that?

chen: I pushed a temporary weight increase during the stress test window, GH #2246, intended for a canary but forgot to pin to canary tag. My bad.

mike: OK — immediate mitigation options: 1) revert weight change 2) apply per-model rate cap in region 3) spin up emergency burst nodes (costly). Thoughts?

lucy: revert is low-risk and quick. but if we revert, traffic might flood other regions (latency sensitive) — need admission control adjustments.

sasha: we tried a light revert draft but autoscaler is slow today (min-replicas locked). could do a temporary rate cap for mosaic-4b in ap-southeast-1 to limit new requests to 40qps until autoscaler finishes.

ops-oncall: +1 for rate cap. spinning new nodes will take >12m so rate-cap buys time.

mike: make the cap conditional on model+region and ensure reserved customers bypass it. can we push a quick config?

chen: putting this out now — rate-limit config snippet:```json
{"region":"ap-southeast-1","model":"mosaic-4b","limit_qps":40,"bypass_tiers":["reserved","enterprise"]}
```

chen: applying to admission-controller -> /configs/overrides/current (hot reload enabled).

infra-bot: [ACTION] applied override by chen at 1745008120; change_id=chg-8821; target=admission-controller; status=success

mike: nice. monitor tail-latency and backlog. I'll keep pages open.

sasha: initial signals: backlog down from 1300 -> 720 in 3m, p95 token latency down ~18%. good.

lucy: cost note — if we spin burst nodes we estimate an extra $1.6k/hr for that AZ due to premium spot-use. prefer not to unless customers are impacted.

mike: agreed. let's keep rate-cap for 30m and revert weight change after we confirm traffic normalizes. chen can you prepare the revert PR and a rollback plan?

chen: PR ready: GH #2251 — revert weight bump + add test for canary-only tag. will merge after 15m if metrics look stable.

ops-oncall: keeping watch. will escalate if reserved customer errors > 0.

mike: tl;dr: root cause = unintended weight bump, mitigation = region-scoped per-model rate cap + planned revert, cost avoided by not bursting extra nodes. nice job on the fast config change. :thumbsup:

sasha: can we also add an alert rule to catch sudden per-model weight changes? might prevent this in future.

mike: yes — add rule: if weight delta > 2x within 1h for non-canary, trigger ops-review. chen add to GH checklist.

chen: noted. will open issue and a small dashboard widget for weight deltas.

infra-bot: [RECOVERY] backlog=210 p95=stable change_id=chg-8821 monitored=10m

mike: closing the thread once PR merges and 1h stable. thanks everyone.
